title: Users
demo_not_ready: After creating this account, choose Configure sandbox from its user menu. Demo sign-in is enabled only after provisioning.
sandbox_help: Prepare a source station, its library and queue, and optional playlists. The sandbox receives independent copies, including audio files. Originals remain unchanged.
sandbox_ready: Sandbox ready: {{station}}, songs: {{count}}. Demo sign-in is enabled.
sandbox_saved: The prepared sandbox state has been restored. Playback is stopped.
sandbox_reset_confirm: Discard guest changes and restore the saved initial state?
sandbox_replace_warning: Preparing again replaces the saved initial state and discards current guest changes. Reset restores the saved seed without copying the current source station again.
subtitle: Manage user accounts and roles.
delete_message: This action cannot be undone. The user will lose access immediately.
